Answer: C
Reason: Comparing the two images, the extensive consolidation initially seen in the left lung (Figure 1) has largely resolved in the follow-up image (Figure 2), while new patchy consolidations have appeared in the right lung. This pattern of resolving infiltrates in one area with simultaneous appearance in another is characteristic of migratory infiltrates, supporting a diagnosis of Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
